change_note: Batches 3-4: bond yields and breakouts, buying at highs, valuation vs euphoria, Mag 7 structure, overextension.

sources.author: Micha (YouTube channel)
sources.title: גוגל נשברת, פלנטיר פורצת — ומה קורה עם האג״ח 10? (Google breaks down, Palantir breaks out, and the 10-year)
principles: When the 10-year yield climbs toward what stocks are expected to earn, money rotates into risk-free paper. Rising long yields are a headwind, hardest on long-duration growth names.
Read why yields rise. Weak growth data plus hawkish signals and a poor auction is worse for stocks than yields rising on strong growth.
Know where inflation comes from. When it sits in business inputs such as memory and chips, the suppliers with pricing power gain and their customers' margins get squeezed.
A thin-volume zone below a broken level is an air pocket. If the level is not reclaimed, price can drop quickly to the next heavy-volume area, which makes that level a clean invalidation.
A breakout is confirmed by rising volume and by old resistance holding as support on the retest. Losing that level again invalidates it.
Fear readings while the index sits near its high signal anxiety beneath the surface. Check breadth and rates before trusting the index level.

observations.text: Fear and Greed read 35 (fear) while the S&P 500 was two days from its all-time high.
The 10-year Treasury yield was cited at 5.11%, driven by weak PMI data, hawkish Fed signals, a poor 5-year auction and crude near 92 dollars.
Inflation was described as driven by business inputs, chiefly memory and semiconductor pricing (for example TSMC price increases), rather than housing or retail.
Alphabet broke below its 150-day average. A thin-volume zone below 345 put 319 to 321 in play unless 345 was reclaimed.
Palantir broke above 188 on rising volume after a base that followed a fall from 207 to 106. Next target cited near 271; 187 had to hold as support.
Amazon launched an AI seller-assistance plugin, read as a push back against Meta's shopping agent.

sources.author: Micha (YouTube channel)
sources.title: הטעות שכולם עושים כשהשוק בשיא — ואיך להימנע ממנה (The mistake everyone makes at market highs)
principles: All-time highs cluster. Strong years print many of them, so a new high is more often followed by more highs than by a crash.
Reluctance to buy at a high is psychology, not math. People waiting for a dip tend to hold out for a bigger one and end up buying back higher.
Historically, investing a lump sum at once beat holding cash for a better entry, partly because highs cluster. Long dry spells do happen, so horizon and diversification still matter.
Being near an all-time high is not, on its own, a reason for a bearish stance. A bearish call needs its own evidence.

observations.text: Cited via Charlie Bilello: 57 all-time highs in 2024, 27 in 2026 to mid-August, and more than 1,400 since 1929, about one trading day in ten.

sources.author: Micha (YouTube channel)
sources.title: בנק אוף אמריקה קובע: המניה הזו עומדת להתחיל לעלות (Bank of America: this stock is about to rise)
principles: Compare a leader's forward P/E with the index's. When a fast grower trades at or below the market multiple, the price implies little growth, and the question becomes what would break.
Parabolic runs in cyclical sectors such as semiconductors often end in deep corrections. Size bullish conviction to how stretched the run is.
Several successful tests of a long moving average followed by a break of the downtrend line is a classic base. Resistance above still caps the first move.
When an industry repurposes its infrastructure for a new wave of demand, such as crypto miners hosting AI compute, new buyers and volume tend to show up before earnings do.
An analyst upgrade is an input, not a verdict. Record it as a dated claim and let scoring judge it.

observations.text: The semiconductor index was cited about 18% below its peak, with a warning that euphoric chip runs often end in 30 to 50% corrections.
Bank of America defended Nvidia: forward P/E about 20 vs 21.3 for the S&P 500, trailing 31 vs 28. About 1T dollars of value was off the peak.
Nvidia tested its 150-day average three times and broke its descending line from the 232 and 213 peaks, with near-term resistance at 212.
Bitcoin miners pivoting to host AI compute (neo-cloud) were drawing new volume and buyers.

sources.author: Micha (YouTube channel)
sources.title: מאגניפיסנט 7 יוציאו את הבורסה מהתקיעות שלה? (Will the Magnificent 7 break the market out of its rut?)
principles: When the index goes sideways for weeks, check its largest members one by one. The next leg usually follows whichever group breaks first: leaders breaking down or laggards bouncing.
Classify each name by structure: higher highs and lows (healthy), a range (waiting for a breakout), or a broken uptrend in a falling channel (repair needed). Stance should follow structure.
A stock that has gone nowhere for years while swinging hard offers volatility, not trend. Keep conviction low until it leaves the range.
A broken name needs a higher high above a named level to reverse. Until then, rallies inside the channel are bounces, and that level is the natural invalidation for a bullish call.

observations.text: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 had moved sideways at the same levels since mid-May, waiting on mega-cap earnings.
Apple broke above 288.62 on rising volume, under 10 dollars from its high, making higher highs and lows.
Amazon had traded sideways since December 2024. A breakout needed a move above 250, and the 150-day average near 234 had to hold.
Alphabet was 12% off its highs but held support at 349 on its 150-day average, keeping the uptrend.
Meta broke its uptrend on 1 Aug 2025 and sat in a falling channel on its 150-week average. It needed to clear 740 to reverse.
Microsoft was about 30% off its highs. Support was cited at 344.70, and it needed to clear 466 for a higher high.
Nvidia corrected from 236 to 194 and sat on long-term rising support and its 150-day average near 192. Holding 185 to 192 kept the bullish structure.
Tesla was described as flat since October 2021 despite wild swings, resting on long-term rising support near 372.

sources.author: Micha (YouTube channel)
sources.title: 13 ימים של ירוק ברצף — השוק חצה את הגבול? (13 green days in a row: did the market cross the line?)
principles: A long streak of up days that lifts the index far above its 20- and 50-day averages is stretched. Expect digestion, often a pullback, before the next leg.
Unfilled gaps below the price are often revisited. Treat them as likely pullback targets, not certainties.
Relief rallies on easing geopolitical risk can be fast and broad. Once that risk premium is gone, the next move needs earnings or data.
When retail chatter crowds into squeezes and speculative themes and sentiment reads greed, tighten risk instead of adding aggressive bullish calls.
The sector that bounces hardest after a selloff is often short covering first. Confirm follow-through before calling it new leadership.

observations.text: Weekly: Nasdaq +6.5%, S&P 500 +4.5% to 7,126 (about +12% in 11 days). Software ETF +13.9%, led by Oracle +26%.
Rally drivers cited: ceasefire hopes, calmer Strait of Hormuz with oil down 7% to 92 dollars, strong bank earnings and a tame PPI print.
Retail chatter focused on Nvidia, Tesla robotaxi, Microsoft, Netflix, an Allbirds pivot, space and quantum names, and squeeze talk in Opendoor and GameStop.
S&P 500 stretched above its 20- and 50-day averages with two or three unfilled gaps below. A pullback toward 7,000 was expected; Fear and Greed read greed.
